name: Spyfall
summary: A social deduction party game where a hidden spy tries to deduce the secret location while others try to identify the spy.
rules_text: Deal one location card face down to each non-spy and a spy card to one random player. All non-spy cards show the same location and a role at that location; the spy sees only that they are spy. Players sit in order and take turns asking any other player a question about the location. Questions must not reveal the location too obviously, but must be answerable by someone who knows it. At any time a player may accuse someone of being spy, call a vote, or the spy may reveal and attempt to guess the location. If all non-spy players agree on the same accused and that player is the spy, non-spies win. If they accuse incorrectly, spy wins. If spy guesses the location correctly, spy wins, otherwise non-spies win. If timer expires without resolution, players must vote.
